concept: An icon button is a small held disc for a single familiar action, with the same touch size and response as a button.

root.why: a round target with an accessible name required by its type, because the icon alone is not read

ghost.why: ghost has no fill for actions in a row of content, the quietest possible mark

md.why: medium is the 44px touch size, the default for any action a thumb will press

sm.why: small is 32px for dense post rows, kept only where space is tight

glass.why: the quiet glass disc for a standalone secondary action, such as edit on a profile

hover.why: hover lifts the disc and brightens a ghost icon, answering the pointer

active.why: a press shrinks the control briefly and faster than hover, because a press is a reply to the reader

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo so the focused control is visible on any scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop glass and fills, so a real system-colour border is drawn to keep the shape visible

background-color.why: the disc fill eases at hover pace with the lift

color.why: a ghost icon brightens over the same duration so colour and lift are one event

transform.why: lift and press use transform over the soft curve so nothing around shifts
